notes: Fresh candidate replication using the current M0-M5 protocol; no v12 observations are reused.
No model-specific M5 prompt addendum is configured.
Promote to frozen only after readiness plus one-instance and five-instance M0-M5 checkpoints pass.
Frozen after the five-instance checkpoint recorded 30/30 valid observations with no infrastructure failures.

M5 demonstrated compatible assistant content and tool calling on all five instances; two runs authored submissions and one invoked the public validator. All five reached the predeclared 12-step budget, which is retained as a valid method outcome rather than tuned per model.
The five-instance checkpoint produced three M4 full passes and zero M5 full passes; method success was not required for operational compatibility.
Execution remains fixed at one worker to avoid concurrency drift and local M5-container contention with the active SINTEF corpus.
